subject.title: Group chat sessions not persisted — only 1 session from 166+ messages

question: Should the remaining fix be a narrow Telegram plain-group last-route persistence change, a shared non-direct session fallback, or deferred until live Telegram restart proof is captured?
rationale: Current source shows a real plain-group route-persistence gap, but the narrow Telegram fix and broader shared fallback have different compatibility and ownership risks, so automation should not choose the permanent boundary alone.

options.title: Prove and fix Telegram plain groups
options.body: Capture live restart proof first, then repair Telegram plain-group route persistence while preserving existing forum-topic behavior.

options.title: Adopt a shared fallback
options.body: Use a shared non-direct delivery-context fallback, but require compatibility review across channel plugins before merge.

options.title: Defer for live proof
options.body: Keep this issue in needs-live-repro until a maintainer or reporter confirms the current-main restart loss path.

recommendation.title: Prove and fix Telegram plain groups
recommendation.body: Capture live restart proof first, then repair Telegram plain-group route persistence while preserving existing forum-topic behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice centers on the shared session recorder boundary that this history ties to steipete.
